Random generation from the skew-normal distribution

rsnorm.Rd

Uses the stochastic representation \(Z = \delta |U| + (1-\delta^2)^{1/2} V\), \(\delta = \alpha/(1+\alpha^2)^{1/2}\), with \(U, V\) independent standard normal (Henze, 1986).

Usage

rsnorm(n, xi = 0, omega = 1, alpha = 0)

Arguments

n

number of observations.

xi, omega, alpha

location, scale and shape (recycled).

Value

Numeric vector of length `n`.

Examples

z <- rsnorm(1000, alpha = 5)
mean(z)  # close to sqrt(2/pi) * 5 / sqrt(26)
#> [1] 0.7845761
